title: Learn AI in 30 Days: A Practical Beginner Practice Plan | Ep 50
description:
Learn AI in 30 Days: A Practical Beginner Practice Plan. Learn with a simple example and a beginner exercise.

AI for Beginners — Episode 50 of 50

What you will learn: Make a realistic practice plan and measure progress.
Example: using AI for ten minutes daily on a real task.
Try it: create a four-week learning calendar.
Remember: skill improves through verification and reflection, not prompt tricks alone.

Follow the series in episode order and practice with sample data. Share your question or exercise result in the comments.
Subscribe to @Techat60 for practical AI tutorials.
